title: Fight for Keeps: A Castle Fight game
author: zndr-cs
selftext:
Remade WC3 Castle Fight in Three.js over a 5-day vibe-code session (Playable in browser!)  
Taking a quick break from my main project, I decided to build a quick side project: a browser remake of **Castle Fight**, the classic Warcraft 3 custom map that my friends and I still play on LAN a few times a year (and where they constantly kick my ass).

For anyone unfamiliar, it’s a lane-based auto-battler: you control a builder, place unit spawners, and your army automatically marches down the lane to destroy the enemy castle.

I spent the last 5 days building this in **Vite, TypeScript, and Three.js** using Claude Code to handle coding and Blender asset gen. I was basically just the "meatbag" directing the vibe.

**Where it’s at right now:**

* **Playable in Browser:** Works best in Chromium (link below).
* **4 Factions:** Humans, Orcs, Undead, and Night Elves—all given their own flavor/lore.
* **Modes:** 1v1 and 2v2 vs AI (Easy/Med/Hard) OR private lobbies vs human friends using room codes.
* **Visuals/UI:** Functional, though Humans look the best right now—the other 3 races could definitely use an asset upgrade soon.

**Play it** [on itch](https://zndr88.itch.io/keeps)

*Disclaimer: Balance is definitely a work-in-progress, and PCs without a dedicated GPU might struggle a bit! Also, naming this thing has unironically been the hardest part of the entire week.*

What started as a 5-day experiment ended up being so much fun that I’m actually tempted to spin the tech into a proper Hero RPG-RTS later (big fan of *Warlords Battlecry* growing up).

Give it a spin and let me know what you think or if you catch any bugs!
